goal: Independently reproduce public vendor OpenAPI contract -> different authentic converter -> actual MCP wire call -> different unmodified external consumer mapper; no live vendor traffic
baseline: P4-D used Meilisearch + CNOE + LangChain; all three organizations differ here

source.error_note: ErrorResponse defines required message and optional code. Concrete code values in local 429 and 456 fixtures are SYNTHETIC. They were not observed from DeepL production.

consumer.scope: Actual MCP consumer result mapper, not a full agent/model run

controls: MCP original structured-only error maps to typed object under same PydanticAI code
All cases flow over actual stdio MCP and loopback HTTP
No calls during generation and no unexpected HTTP methods or paths
adjustments: Extract original declared GET operation with its complete transitive component references; no change to its responses or schemas
Replace server with loopback replay and remove vendor auth requirements in projected local-only copy
Deterministic synthetic code values use permitted optional code field, not attributed to DeepL operations
safety: No external vendor API, API key, LLM, write request, or account token
Network enabled only for pinned public source/dependency installation during Docker build
Offline nonroot runtime with no network, read-only filesystem, dropped capabilities
No automatic upstream bug report or modification
